profile.headline: Senior Mission Software Engineer at Anduril
profile.summary: I’m a software engineer with over a decade of experience designing and building secure, reliable, scalable software. I’ve designed and built distributed systems, written software for satellites, and much more. I drive the engineering process forward in every aspect, from design to review to implementation to long-term maintenance. I have experience working directly with business development and other stakeholders to design solutions for customers, as well as taking those designs and turning them into reality. I firmly believe that customers deserve, good, reliable software, and that all software should be secure—by default.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineering team lead for the Aranya platform (decentralized, zero-trust DAG; Rust).
- Responsible for the design, review, and implementation of the Aranya platform.
- Responsible for the cryptographic design, review, and implementation of all SpiderOak products.
- Developed software in a variety of languages (Rust, Go, C, Java, Kotlin, Assembly, and more).
- Developed software for a variety of platforms (x86, ARM, PowerPC e500, and more).
- Designed and implemented Aranya Fast Channels to provide line-rate, end-to-end encrypted, transport-agnostic data channels.
- Integrated Aranya and other products with a wide range of customer systems (embedded VxWorks, Docker containers on cube sats, and more).
- Performed security R&D during Aranya’s R&D phase.
- Lead backend engineer for CrossClave (E2EE team collaboration app; Go).
- Built CrossClave backend microservices on top of AWS (S3, ECS, KMS) and Azure.
- Implemented E2EE metrics and log collection for end-user devices.
- Integrated CrossClave backend with third-party services (Auth0, APNS, FCM).
- Integrated products with customer TPMs (Secure Enclave, Android TEE, Windows NCrypt).
- Led CSfC and Common Criteria certification project.
